name: Infestation 4-Star Legendary Mods
categories: Armor • Power Armor • Weapon: Ranged • Weapon: Melee
description: High-tier 4th star legendary mods dropped exclusively from Infestation endgame events and faction bosses. Requires 100 Scrip and 120 Legendary Modules to apply.
notes: Datamined from Patch 70 Infestation Event tables. Subject to change before live release.

name: Unique Weapon & Armor Modding
description: Allows players to modify legendary effects on named unique items at workbenches. Players can now add a 4th legendary star to unique items.
notes: Enables full legendary customization of iconic unique quest rewards and boss drops.

name: Normalized Scrip Modding Costs
description: Scrip costs for changing legendary mods are now fixed values rather than escalating per attempt. 1-Star, 2-Star, and 3-Star mods cost 50 Scrip. 4-Star mods cost 100 Scrip.
notes: Removes escalating Scrip penalties, making iterative mod testing significantly cheaper.

name: Psychophant's
description: +40% Damage vs Cryptids and Cultists. Hits generate +25% AP refresh for 5 seconds.
notes: New 4-star effect introduced in Patch 70 'Psychophants Of Appalachia'.

name: Radioactive Surge
description: Taking Radiation Damage grants +50 Energy Resistance and +5% Movement Speed for 30s (Stacks up to 4x).
notes: Experimental 4th star defensive effect for Bloodied and Nuke Zone builds.

name: Infestation Faction Boss Rewards
description: Random dynamic endgame event spawning faction bosses across Appalachia. Completing Infestations awards guaranteed 4-Star Mod Boxes and Vault Steel.
notes: High-difficulty endgame loop designed for Level 300+ players.
